author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin Gausman shelled early in loss to Rangers
desc: Kevin Gausman allowed six earned runs on 10 hits and two walks while striking out four over six innings in Thursday's 6-5 loss to the Rangers.
impact: Gausman has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in four of his last five starts. The right-hander has fought inconsistent command for much of the season, posting a 4.36 ERA and 1.19 WHIP with a 4-6 record and 8.8 K/9 ratio across 17 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Troy Melton cruises on mound in loss to Astros
desc: Troy Melton allowed one earned run on two hits while striking out six over six innings in Thursday's loss to the Astros.
impact: Melton has been steady on the mound since being called up, allowing two earned runs or less in five of his six trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager AJ Hinch another stable starting option in the Tigers rotation, posting a 2.39 ERA and 0.85 WHIP with a 4-1 record and 2.8 K/BB ratio through six starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adam Macko recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays recalled Adam Macko from Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: There should be a corresponding move announced before first pitch for Toronto on Friday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dillon Dingler goes deep in loss to Astros
desc: Dillon Dingler went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Astros with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Dingler continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in 12 of his last 21 contests. The catcher remains one of the few impactful bats in a disappointing Tigers lineup, carrying an .879 OPS with 19 home runs, 57 RBI, and 42 runs scored across 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Henry Bolte racks up three hits in win over Giants
desc: Henry Bolte went 3-for-5 in a win over the Giants with one run scored.
impact: Bolte has caught fire at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last eight contests. The outfielder remains one of the more reliable options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, batting .320 with two home runs, 10 RBI, 12 runs scored, and nine stolen bases across 39 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jeff McNeil picks up three hits in win over Giants
desc: Jeff McNeil went 3-for-4 in a win over the Giants with a walk, two runs scored, and one RBI.
impact: McNeil is in the midst of an underwhelming stretch at the plate, picking up hits in just four of his last 10 contests. The veteran is one of many underperforming bats in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, hitting .237 with three home runs, 20 RBI, 21 runs scored, and one stolen base through 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Lawrence Butler chips in two hits and a steal in win
desc: Lawrence Butler went 2-for-5 in a win over the Giants with a double, two runs scored, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Butler continues a solid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in six of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains another underwhelming option in the Athletics lineup to this point, batting .197 with five home runs, six stolen bases, 28 runs scored, and 21 RBI across 73 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Max Muncy steals base in win over Giants
desc: Max Muncy went 1-for-5 in a win over the Giants with two RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Muncy has been productive at the plate of late, driving in runs in each of his last three contests. The infielder remains one of the more underperforming bats in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, slashing .229 with five home runs, 20 RBI, 20 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 39 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jeffrey Springs labors on mound against Giants
desc: Jeffrey Springs allowed three earned runs on three hits and two walks while striking out six over 5 1/3 innings in Thursday's win over the Giants.
impact: Springs has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last five contests. The left-hander remains an underwhelming starting option in the Athletics rotation, posting a 5.52 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with an 8.0 K/9 ratio and 3-7 record across 17 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Cronenworth (concussion) to begin rehab assignment Friday
desc: Jake Cronenworth will begin his rehab assignment at Triple-A El Paso on Friday.
impact: Cronenworth has been on the concussion injured list since the first week of March. He'll likely require a lengthy rehab assignment before he returns.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lance McCullers Jr. (shoulder) throws 42 pitches in rehab start
desc: Lance McCullers Jr. threw 42 pitches over three shutout innings for Triple-A Sugar Land on Thursday in a rehab start.
impact: McCullers allowed two hits and struck out four. He will likely require at least a couple more rehab starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willy Adames goes deep in loss to Athletics
desc: Willy Adames went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Athletics with a home run, a walk, two runs scored and one RBI.
impact: Adames continues a solid stretch at the plate, collecting hits in six of his last 10 contests. The shortstop remains one of the more frustrating options in a streaky Giants lineup, batting .225 with 14 homers, 32 RBI, 40 runs scored, and one stolen base through 78 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Mendoza fired by Mets
desc: The Mets have fired manager Carlos Mendoza.
impact: The Mets hold the third-worst record in the NL at 34-47 despite having one of the largest payrolls in baseball. Mendoza was 206-199 in just over two years as the Mets manager, but a move seemed inevitable given their poor start. Andy Green is taking over as interim manager for the remainder of the season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jung Hoo Lee drives in three in loss to A's
desc: Jung Hoo Lee went 1-for-4 in loss to the Athletics with a triple, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Lee has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in seven of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the few dynamic bats in a streaky Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .332 with five homers, 30 RBI, 41 runs scored, and five steals through 72 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Victor Bericoto homers in loss to A's
desc: Victor Bericoto went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Athletics with a two-run home run.
impact: Bericoto has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in each of the last two games. The outfielder remains one of many streaky options when in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, batting .231 with three home runs, four RBI, and three runs scored across 15 games.
